items.title: William "Ba Ba" Ridgley Interview, 1961-04-07
items.q: Now who did give us our start with her was Miss Caroline Benjamin.

ctx.x: Yeah. I got a phone up I've been trying to get all yesterday.

She don't want to answer you. She wants that phone out of me. Tell me she's doing good. She's getting by one of the old tuxedo band people that had noticed and wanted a short bang, you know. And they didn't like her. Now who did give us our start with her was Miss Caroline Benjamin. St. John and Joseph Street. Now she was a good banjo, a guitar player and a good piano, a good musician. And her and several other young white girls. And they used to come around us when we played and they liked the way that Sweet…
Did they sit in with her, you know, and with you all and play some of those society people? Would they ever play with you? Who was that?
